status: Candidate artwork; author visual acceptance pending

brief.purpose: World ingredient models, transparent inventory sprites and regional deposit candidates
brief.direction: Owned low-poly, muted pixel-oriented dark fantasy in nineteenth-century Argentina
brief.protected: Accepted iodine mesh and all existing resource gameplay; no new gameplay quantities or material IDs
brief.views: One 128x128 transparent orthographic icon per model; native gallery supports all-around inspection
brief.lighting: Matte mineral crusts, charcoal with woody fractures, worn wood, cork, ceramic and dark glass; no glow
brief.exclude: Text labels on artwork, formulas, manufacturing instructions, modern packaging, invented magical or medical effects
brief.processing: Deterministic original geometry and procedural textures; icons rasterized from the same textured meshes with a depth buffer
brief.acceptance: Inspect every icon, compare native models from multiple sides, inspect real iodine inventory and confirm CA471-ART-01

provenance: Original project geometry and procedural textures. Iodine reuses the unchanged #407 mesh. No external artwork or AI-painted source.
rules: Representation only: vessels and model dimensions imply no inventory mass, capacity, recipe or price. Regional deposit candidates are not placed in MAP03. No real propellant formulation is represented.
